## Purpose and status

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This continuation uses three GPT-6.2 Astra research lanes to test unconventional approaches against the actual positive-integer map. It adds arithmetic restrictions on one hypothetical escaping source, exact finite escape observables, cycle-order restrictions and counterexamples, and a concrete checked Lean endpoint. It does not prove the two universal obligations.

[Scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/research/unconventional-20261126/README.md) · [Final mathematical proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/research/unconventional-20261126/FINAL_PROPOSAL.md) · [Final coordinator review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/reports/unconventional-20261126/FINAL_REVIEW.md) · [Executed scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/reports/unconventional-20261126/README.md)

## Most consequential additions

- **Actual shifted cofactors.** On every hypothetical fixed ordinary escape, at least a lower fraction log₃2 of native times have simultaneous nearly full logarithmic cofactors for any fixed finite rational shift set and one adaptive bounded-cardinality prime pool per entire prefix. Nonperiodic shifts have fraction one. A separate argument treats a sequence of distinct hypothetical positive cycles with minima tending to infinity. The Subspace Theorem uses fixed places; the moving prime pool enters the elementary return identity.
- **Elementary nonlinear observables.** For a fixed integral polynomial with no rational root, any N distinct consecutive ordinary states have at most O(√N+r+r(1+log(2r))N/log N) cofactor exceptions against a single r-prime pool, uniformly over source and prime values. An integer affine-return resultant is nonzero for every irreducible factor of degree at least two. The proof credits the prime-valuation counting method of Weaver's paper 138.
- **Compulsory log-height arithmetic.** Positive record roofs supply mass even when odd-time occupation vanishes. Outside the specified negative signed-cycle neighborhoods, exceptional prime-cofactor roof is O(√N) for bounded pools and O(1+√(Nr log(2r))) for growing pools. The conclusion after normalization requires comparison with the actual running peak. Slow growth, diffuse mass, and infinite-label alternatives remain open.
- **Physical finite exit gates.** The sorted exact gate weights converge in ℓ¹ to one positive mass per escaping ordinary component. Their augmented total is monotone. A thin explicit critical gate sieve has cardinality O(X^θ/(log X)^(3/2)); at s=2 the weight outside it is Θ(log X/X). Vanishing weighted mass on the sieve is the specific missing no-escape estimate.
- **Integer cycle order and an actual failed shortcut.** The dyadic-lift inversion bound uses a primitive cycle's least native period N and distinct odd count p. It constrains gcd(N,p), but leaves the coprime sector. Starts 859 and 860 have the same contracting 46-step/29-odd multiplier and images 890 and 866, both above both starts. The exact counterexample is checked in Lean.
- **Controls that expose the remaining denominator issue.** The new integer interval test rejects both large coherent rational fixtures. A separate analytic theorem shows that coprime near-critical rational cycles have disjoint perturbation arcs and pass even that stronger test. The full denominator-one equation, except words on the known cycle, remains unresolved.

The first checkpoint also contains the reviewed critical Hausdorff threshold including its endpoint, fixed-source periodic-window and rational-diagonal obstructions, coherent high-minimum rational cycles, and physical operator constructions. The report preserves each argument's review scope and dependencies.

## Final combined closing audit

[The closing audit](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/research/unconventional-20261126/CLOSING_AUDIT.md) computes an explicit rational point in the actual critical ternary trace at each genuine coefficient record. Its moving denominator is exactly a growing power of two, and its cleared moving polynomial has a constant cofactor outside the prime 3. This identifies why fixed-polynomial arithmetic estimates cannot be applied uniformly to that moving witness. A separate exact product calculation leaves a positive residual in the direct two-coordinate Subspace attempt.

The audit also proves that the nonlinear resultant restrictions survive on cleared primitive coordinates of large-denominator rational cycles. It explicitly retains the difference between this exponential-denominator family and the subexponential-denominator coherent controls; no single family satisfying every proposed filter is claimed. All three agents independently reconstructed the audit, with two final qualifications recorded in the coordinator review.

## Exact Lean endpoint

`FinalProposal.lean` proves:

`Collatz ↔ NoEscape ∧ CycleUnique`.

`FiniteExit.lean` supplies a terminating Boolean test for the first X+1 actual states staying below X, and proves:

`Collatz ↔ FiniteTrapping ∧ CycleUnique`.

**Neither universal proposition on the right is proved.** They are definitions, not replacement axioms or hidden placeholders. Every successful finite test certifies repetition, and repetition supplies such a test; the open assertion is existence for every positive source.

## Executed evidence

- **64 unique declarations in twelve exact Lean files**, combining the initial, trapping, and order replays. Rebuilt dependencies are counted once. Lean 4.34.1, commit 5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52; Mathlib d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612. Warnings were errors. Printed axioms were subsets of propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound.
- **Nine root-replayed finite scripts, eighteen executions**: normal and optimized Python agree byte for byte and match their complete recorded JSON. The largest coherent fixture checks all 865,445 native transitions and all-phase interval separation; it tests exactly primes 5 and 71.
- The extra pair-overlap tables were executed independently by two research agents. The coordinator inspected their method but did not rerun those extra tables; they are not counted in the nine-program total.
- [Final source aggregation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/reports/unconventional-20261126/FINAL_SOURCE_CHECK.json) verifies the current formal/control bytes against the successful receipts. [The manifest](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/reports/unconventional-20261126/SOURCE_MANIFEST.json) binds 151 files and excludes itself.
- **All five required repository checks passed on the clean complete published 523-file checkout** at commit 21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a, tree be6654e2251519f6b5231c67b3a4862cb42c9500. The remote tree matched the prepared local tree exactly and the actual published commit was fetched back before this validation.

Repository checks establish structure and frozen identity. Finite Lean/control replays establish their stated interfaces. The infinite analytic arguments remain proposed written mathematics with scoped independent agent reconstructions.

## Preservation and remaining proof boundary

The preceding PR description is preserved in [PREVIOUS_PR.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/21bed7ac2b1b1bb4baf0f6cabd53f8b9dd11b58a/reports/unconventional-20261126/PREVIOUS_PR.json). The old two-run interval has an explicit erratum; historical failed broad-import Lean attempts and successful import-only fallbacks remain distinguished. The first published checkpoint's concrete receipts are retained.

The intake covered metadata for thirty current PRs and selected proof interfaces, not a line-by-line audit of the full repository. Literature and earlier PR dependencies are attributed; no external formal release or large predecessor computation was rebuilt. The draft remains a research continuation.

- The earlier reviewed written pressure proof gives \(r(B_p)=\max(1,3p)\) for \(0<p<1\), hence the classical Bergman transfer radius \(\sqrt{20}/3\), with the stated space and quotient retained. This analytic theorem is not fully formalized.
- On one supplied ordinary path with \(r\) complete resets, the persistent odd divisor satisfies \(g^{r+1}2^{T+t_r}\le C_{r,\epsilon}Y^{1+\epsilon}\). The full gcd of the \(r+1\) shifted boundary values is at most \(Y^{1/(r+1)+o(1)}\). There are sharp ordinary CRT controls, and a refinement using reset-depth ratios. The new written proof uses Evertse's published theorem; the source hypotheses were checked.
- Finite squareclass rank of shifted reset entrances is equivalent to eventual periodicity. At each fixed rank there are only finitely many ordinary cycles. This extends the newly pinned PR192 elementary translate argument to shifted reset boundaries; it does not force finite rank on every orbit.
- Reversing two distinct complete blocks cannot yield an integral compensating entrance at a common terminal satisfying \(3(z+1)\ge x+1\). The written reduction reaches 2,880 exact cases, checked by Lean. Below that floor, an ordinary merger example shows the limitation.
- The finite positive harmonic exit gates have a source-qualified sorted \(\ell^1\) limit equal to weighted escaping-component charges. A vanishing subsequence of their totals would exclude escape; no such bound is proved. This is an endpoint extension of PR201's summable-source gates.
- The exact finite calculation \(B_{14}>B_{13}\) rules out global nonincrease of the centered harmonic sum. Reflection preserves the complete inverse-pressure family while changing the sign-sensitive harmonic head. The underlying harmonic-head identity is prior Weaver Paper 176 work, explicitly credited after the late intake.
- Fixed-modulus cancellation is classified and realized on primitive positive rational cycles while their **full reduced denominators** stay exponentially large. Their real phase values are of order the square of the odd period. These are controls for an ordinary-integer argument, not ordinary counterexamples.

Large families of successful queries and finite periodic certificates do not themselves cover every surviving original source. This pass develops stronger exact ordinary implications and tests the assumptions that would be needed to turn them into a universal argument.

## Main mathematical changes

- **General periodic-wall exclusion.** For every binary word whose two signed numerator references enter cycles with positive odd counts, ordinary mixed walls have a word-dependent cap on new repetitions, eventually at every alignment. The proof balances distinct cycle laps, lifts their actual integer endpoints, and applies an affine merger in a prescribed binary class. For `1011`, a separately replayed 854-leaf certificate gives the eventual cap of 81 copies.
- **Block depth and physical clocks separated.** Equal cycle rates give a uniform cap from the first position, including distinct within-word reference phases. General positive cycles give block depth at most `A*v+B`, where `v` is the initial binary valuation. A period-18 theorem simultaneously proves that every fixed physical horizon misses all mergers at every pair of block depths for some positive ordinary source. Thus the block cap does not bound physical runtime.
- **Every smaller ordinary source.** Write `x+1=2^n*b` with `b` odd. If `x<2^j*a-1` and `3` does not divide `a`, any meeting with ascent phase `3^u*2^(j-u)*a-1`, `u<=j`, requires `h>n+u`. The exact family `x=(8M-5)/9`, `M=2^j-1`, `j=5 mod 6`, shows that first contact is essential; it is too large for the original factor-`2^40` query budget.

## Current result: unconventional three-hour pass, 26 November 2026

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This update strengthens the bounded-counterexample reduction, proves thirteen infinite-family exclusions under the explicit least-disagreement floor, and closes a qualitative inverse-routing theorem with both grades prescribed. ### Strongest positive reduction

On the pinned bounded bad-cycle alternative, the descending run into the global minimum has length r in {2,3,4,5}. The least canonical disagreement z and minimum s satisfy
`s >= 1 + (243/1024)(z-1)`.
A divisibility condition forces z onto the cycle; it always does so for r=2.

If the first upper hit of 3z has exactly three odd departures, all middle even gaps e=6,...,48 are eliminated except e=6 for r=3,4,5. There is no survivor for r=2. The e=8 and e=10 exclusions use explicit smaller canonical disagreements, rather than only a numerical drop. A surviving row reaches the first bad Mersenne
`M_j = 2^j - 1, j = 11 mod 162`, with good triple `3M_j`.
That remaining case, other upper odd counts, and the first-crossing alternative are not closed.

[Bounded floor](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/51d97cbe17054415acaf95e422801a3532545033/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/cycle/CANONICAL_FLOOR.md) · [Three-odd reduction](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/51d97cbe17054415acaf95e422801a3532545033/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/renormalization/BOUNDED_RANK_THREE.md) · [Formal floor](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/51d97cbe17054415acaf95e422801a3532545033/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/cycle/CanonicalFloor.lean) · [Formal return identities](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/51d97cbe17054415acaf95e422801a3532545033/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/renormalization/RankThreeFloor.lean).

## Result and scope

This PR records the three-hour unconventional Collatz attack of 26 November 2026, with three GPT-6.2 Astra research agents and independent coordinating review. It builds on the full prior PR tree and the scientific heads recorded in the intake.

**Universal Collatz termination remains open.** The work gives an exact ordinary escape statistic, a signed cancellation target, a classification of finite-exponent holonomic flows, and ordinary boundary exclusions. It does not prove the required cancellation or rule out all positive cycles.

Start with the [closing proposal](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fd385ebf14866955b0ce8c95998d80da36a7336f/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/CLOSING_PROPOSAL.md), then the [complete overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fd385ebf14866955b0ce8c95998d80da36a7336f/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/README.md). The mathematical review and qualifications are in [REVIEW.md](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fd385ebf14866955b0ce8c95998d80da36a7336f/reports/astra-unconventional-20261126/REVIEW.md).

## Main changes

### Original-law escape test and the actual source of collision mass

For the original geometric exponent law, write rho_k(y) = 3^k p_k(y mod 3^k) and Phi(u) = u²/(1+u), summing over positive odd representatives y < 2·3^k.

Under the explicitly named source inputs, the sum of Phi(rho_k(y)/y) is o(k) if and only if every positive orbit is eventually periodic. The finite sum requires no first-hit test or cycle enumeration. The stronger component-spectrum theorem identifies its normalized limit as the sum of Phi(H_C) over escaping components.

The final independent proof uses an exact positive two-copy transfer and a summable source from distinct ordinary parents at their first merger. It removes every periodic first-hit target and every repeated cycle lap, permitting arbitrarily many cycles. The zero criterion no longer needs the global minimum law, moving-target profile, or harmonic first-moment theorem. Its local first-hit, fixed-target trace, atom-floor and interval-compression inputs remain explicit.

- [Collision spectrum, amplitudes and signed test](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fd385ebf14866955b0ce8c95998d80da36a7336f/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/global/COLLISION_ENERGY.md)
- [Independent ordinary pair-source proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/fd385ebf14866955b0ce8c95998d80da36a7336f/research/astra-unconventional-20261126/boundary/COLLISION_SOURCE.md)

The signed test uses values (-1, 3, -5, 3)/4 on odd residues modulo eight. Every escape forces positive normalized drift. A zero upper bound along a subsequence would exclude escape, but that estimate is not proved.

Controls retain the distinction between exact ordinary dynamics and nearby laws. A perturbation can preserve every quotient through k-O(log k), have exponentially small total variation error, and still change the signed statistic by a positive constant. Actual trajectories reaching 1 disprove the proposed uniform bounded/logarithmic drift potentials; their killed twisted transfer already has the full spectral disk. The specific source-weighted cancellation remains the target.

### Holonomic rigidity for every finite exponent ceiling

The exact all-gap incidence equation transfers ternary sections of depth k to sums of binary sections at depths k through Ek, retaining merged incoming branches. The written differential-module proof uses Levelt–Turrittin slopes, actual singularities of all continuations, and regular singularity at infinity.

Every formal complex D-finite solution is polynomial, including initially divergent formal series and signed solutions. The polynomial solutions are finite sums of actual ordinary cycle indicators. Weighted branches are included. This classification does not eliminate nontrivial cycle indicators.

### Ordinary boundary exclusions

Paired signed references are returned to actual positive integer lifts with equal odd counts and different physical clocks. Rational persistent boundaries whose two reference arms are eventually nonzero periodic are excluded. The worked necklace has an exact finite fusion certificate. Zero arms and general aperiodic boundaries remain separate.
